replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA reduces data dimensions by finding directions (principal components) that capture most variance. First, standardize your data. Then, compute the covariance matrix and its eigenvectors. The eigenvectors give the new axes, and eigenvalues show variance.
